rows.surface: Tenant-private profile, billing, chat, tip and ingestion data
rows.whatCanGoWrong: A user reads or mutates another tenant's private state.

evidence.summary: Forced RLS on sensitive tables.
Ownership policies continued.
Cross-tenant denial exercised via non-BYPASSRLS role on PostgreSQL.
cross-tenant-access certificate proven blocking through ci-fast / Structural Contract.

rows.surface: Signup, provider identity binding and account uniqueness
rows.whatCanGoWrong: A provider identity, email or Stripe customer maps to more than one user.

evidence.summary: Unique identity constraints.
Provider constraints.

rows.surface: Billing entitlement writes and Stripe Connect mapping
rows.whatCanGoWrong: Concurrent entitlement writers silently overwrite each other or one Connect account maps to multiple payout profiles.

evidence.summary: billing_version compare-and-swap plus billing audit FK.
Partial unique Connect-account index.
Races both concurrency boundaries on PostgreSQL.
checkout-billing journey SLO with Stripe/Postgres SLI sources.

rows.surface: Retryable mutations, webhook consumers and idempotency locks
rows.whatCanGoWrong: A retry or provider redelivery duplicates a business effect, or a Redis outage silently drops exclusion.

evidence.summary: SET NX EX lock contract.
Cache/Redis degradation contract.
Fault injection: outage at acquire, mid-operation flap, release failure, post-recovery arbitration.
duplicate-retry-effect certificate.
Upstash operability canary owns the standing alert.
Fail-closed/typed-degradation policy.
Post-recovery arbitration asserted; locks self-heal at TTL.

rows.surface: Save and publish acknowledgements
rows.whatCanGoWrong: The product acknowledges a write that never persisted.

evidence.summary: Acknowledgement requires a durable save receipt.
false-success-save certificate.

rows.surface: Cache invalidation after mutation and revocation
rows.whatCanGoWrong: A mutation or revocation leaves stale cached state readable.

evidence.summary: Invalidation lives in the shared cache module; coverage of every mutation path is unverified.
stale-cache-after-mutation certificate.

rows.surface: Certification and promotion evidence pipeline
rows.whatCanGoWrong: Missing, stale, forged, swallowed or non-applicable evidence is counted green and certifies a change.

evidence.summary: Only the executable harness may set certified:true; models always get false.
Unknown applicability and rejected evidence states fail closed.
Deliberate reds for every representative defect and tampered certifier.
invalid-evidence-counted-green certificate consumed by Structural Contract on ci-fast.
Composed validator re-runs the contract on every invariant pass.
Rejection receipts are typed and immutable; containment is the gate itself.

rows.surface: Production artifact and runtime-config promotion
rows.whatCanGoWrong: The promoted artifact or runtime config differs from what was certified.

evidence.summary: Provenance binds promoted inputs to the certified build.
artifact-config-mismatch certificate; promotion boundary is the production promotion controller.

rows.surface: Public marketing and smartlink readability
rows.whatCanGoWrong: A shipped UI change makes foreground/background contrast unreadable.

evidence.summary: Semantic token authority.
Contrast ratchet lints web UI color/token changes.
unreadable-contrast certificate.

rows.surface: P0 journey production observability
rows.whatCanGoWrong: A P0 journey fails in production with no outcome-bound SLI, alert owner, or correlation path.

evidence.summary: Typed registry forces outcome SLI/SLO, alert severity, owner, runbook and trace hops per P0 journey.
Alert wiring exists as typed registry; live paging not yet proven end-to-end.

rows.surface: Agent-run outcome truth and tool-safety certification
rows.whatCanGoWrong: An agent or eval run reports success its evidence does not prove.

evidence.summary: Claim vs evidence vs explicit outcome; harness-only certification.
Certifier tampering cannot manufacture certification (deliberate red).

rows.surface: Test-strength on critical paths
rows.whatCanGoWrong: Mutation-viable but assertion-weak tests let defects through while coverage looks green.

evidence.summary: Mutation testing configured; not yet a blocking lane.

rows.surface: Commissioned capability claims
rows.whatCanGoWrong: A capability is declared commissioned without runtime receipts.

evidence.summary: Receipt trust policy; claims require runtime receipts.
Blocked capabilities are recorded, but commissioning is not wired as a promotion gate.
Architecture-freshness rescan invalidates stale commissioning claims.

rows.surface: Schema migration safety and drift
rows.whatCanGoWrong: A migration ships dirty state, drops a needed structure, or diverges from the effective schema.

evidence.summary: Migration fails on dirty duplicate mappings instead of deleting or choosing a winner.
migration:validate + drizzle:check are the certification commands.
Ephemeral-Neon CI lane exists; blocking proof not yet bound per JOV-6042 promotion criteria.

rows.surface: Shared UI primitives, icons, controls and design tokens
rows.whatCanGoWrong: Non-canonical or forked controls, raw icons, off-scale size/radius/type, superseded visual variants (e.g. chevron rail toggles) re-enter while semantic tests stay green.

blindSpots: Glyph identity of shell controls is not guarded; the rail-toggle source guard locks in the banned arrow variant.
No deliberate-red primitive fork proven through the real PR Ready consumer.
Native iOS primitives are outside these web guards.

rows.surface: Rendered layout geometry of registered screens and shell compositions
rows.whatCanGoWrong: Overlap, clipping, overflow, unintended scrollbars, double insets, misaligned top rows, unstable heights, content under fixed chrome, or layout shift ship while source checks pass.

blindSpots: Rendered screen certification runs only after merge (screenshots.yml) and is red on main; nothing blocks before merge.
Header/title alignment tolerance in storybook-elevation equals 2px + content inset; title x has only a lower bound (JOV-7207 audit).
Zoom/text-resize never exercised.

rows.surface: Surface material and five-level elevation across composed shell routes
rows.whatCanGoWrong: One logical main/table surface renders as several arbitrary background materials, header/body seams, nested boxes without semantic elevation, elevation inversions, or light/dark drift.

blindSpots: No composed real-shell route (tables, library, tasks, chat, entity rail) is checked for single-material main surface.
No computed-background assertion across header+body of one semantic level.

rows.surface: Shell, rail, player and component motion
rows.whatCanGoWrong: Dead time before response, desynchronized width/opacity/translate, non-interruptible or non-reversible transitions, stale transforms after repeated cycles, reduced-motion violations, raw motion values.

blindSpots: No runtime capture of initial/mid/final geometry for rail/player transitions.
No repeated-cycle drift (ghost width, stale transform) check.
No reduced-motion consumer audit.

rows.surface: Reversible controls and interaction state machines
rows.whatCanGoWrong: A control works from one state only, open without close, stale state after hydration, pointer/keyboard desync, lost focus, hidden/inert control after transition, double-bound handlers.

blindSpots: No reversible-control transition-graph certification yet (expanded->collapsed->expanded, repeated, keyboard, mixed input, hydrated); detector lands in #20397.
apps/ovie app-shell invariants check source strings (e.g. titlebar marker) rather than rendered geometry.

rows.surface: Per-surface UI state coverage (loading, empty, error, partial, stale, locked, offline)
rows.whatCanGoWrong: A surface ships without a required state, invents a success empty state, shows stale content as current, or silently falls through an unsupported state.

blindSpots: Declared requiredStates are not proven to render; no per-state rendered capture on exact build.
Late-arriving data semantic swaps are not modelled as a state.

rows.surface: Accessibility of app and public UI (names, keyboard, focus, targets, zoom)
rows.whatCanGoWrong: Missing names/roles/states, unreachable keyboard paths, invisible or lost focus, small targets, broken Escape, reduced-motion or 200% zoom failures.

blindSpots: Story axe lane is not a merge gate and has been red for days without remediation routing.
No 200% zoom / text-scaling check.
Focus continuity after shell transitions not asserted.

rows.surface: Responsive, mobile and packaged-desktop parity of supported surfaces
rows.whatCanGoWrong: Desktop assumptions break mobile, drawer/sheet/rail parity drifts, safe areas or orientation break, packaged Mac differs from browser for the same surface.

blindSpots: Mobile proof only exists in the post-merge screen-certification run.
Packaged Mac parity verified manually through dogfood ledgers, not machine-compared.

rows.surface: Content and data-dependent robustness of rendered UI
rows.whatCanGoWrong: Long names/locales, missing images, zero/large counts, bad aspect ratios, dynamic columns or late-arriving data break geometry or semantics.

blindSpots: No stress-content fixtures (long strings, missing media, extreme counts) run against primitives or screens.
Artwork must route through ArtworkFrame (JOV-5455) but adoption is not ratcheted; raw artwork images can bypass it.

rows.surface: Visual quality and taste boundary on exact-build captures
rows.whatCanGoWrong: A surface passes every deterministic check yet looks mediocre, or an AI aesthetic score masks a deterministic failure.

blindSpots: No bounded visual evaluator on exact-build captures compared against approved Pen references.
Taste scores must never override deterministic RED; enforced by policy only.
